memories.content: The atlas release build is repeatedly cancelled by CI because a cold cargo registry cache (no cache persisted between builds) adds ~18 minutes to every release build, leaving only ~12 minutes of margin under atlas CI's 30-minute hard job timeout; any minor slowdown in the actual build pushes it over and CI kills the job. Fix: persist/restore the cargo registry cache (and ideally target/) between release builds keyed on Cargo.lock, rather than just raising the timeout.
